summary.name: Nozbe
summary.one_liner: Nozbe is a task and project management app for individuals and teams, with tasks, comments, and file sharing organized into shared projects.
summary.what_it_does:
Nozbe organizes work into projects, sections, and tasks that can be assigned to team members. Comments and file attachments are attached directly to tasks so discussion stays with the work. Separate spaces can be used for work, teams, or personal projects under one account. Users can forward emails to create tasks, reuse project templates, and use the app on iPhone, iPad, Android, desktop, and web, with offline support. The page also mentions an optional AI feature for generating projects from ideas and an MCP option.</what_it_does>
